title: Snowden's revelations about Bullrun and PRISM

tellings.quote: we know we know from Snowden they had back doors they Bull run and prism and I don't think this was done unbeknownst to Google and Apple

plain: The 2013 leaks by Edward Snowden, a former US intelligence contractor, showed that American spy agencies had "back doors" into technology through programs called Bullrun and PRISM, Michels says, and he does not believe this happened without Google and Apple knowing. He makes the point himself on a 2025 episode with the UFO activist Steven Greer. He uses it to argue that big tech companies and the government work closely together in keeping secrets.
